info.title: Monero Wallet RPC
info.description:
JSON-RPC API for interacting with monero-wallet-rpc. The program monero-wallet-rpc replaced the rpc interface that was in simplewallet and then monero-wallet-cli. Like monero daemon, if authentication has been setup, the user has to make sure to send the username and credentials in the `Authorization` HTTP Header.

Note:
- *"atomic units"* refer to the smallest fraction of monero according to the monerod implementation. **1 XMR = 1e12 [atomic units](https://www.getmonero.org/resources/moneropedia/atomic-units.html).**
- An account or address index is its time-based place in the entire list. eg. the primary account is the account of index 0, the primary address is the address of index 0. An address with an index > 0 is a *subaddress*.

in_pool.description: `true` if the transaction is still in the mempool (unconfirmed).

confirmations.description: Number of confirmations the transaction has. `0` while it is still in the pool.

signature.description: The spend proof signature string. Begins with `SpendProofV...` and can be verified with `check_spend_proof`.

good.description: `true` if the signature proves the wallet spent the inputs of the given transaction.

signature.description: The reserve proof signature string. Begins with `ReserveProofV...` and can be verified with `check_reserve_proof`.

signature.description: The signature over the supplied data. Begins with `SigV...`.

good.description: `true` if the signature is valid for the given data and address.

old.description: `true` if the signature uses the older (pre-versioned) signature scheme.

signature_type.description: Which key produced the signature: `spend`, `view`, or `invalid`.

TransferEntry.description: A single transfer (incoming, outgoing, pending, failed, or pool) as recorded by the wallet.

payment_id.description: Payment ID associated with the transfer (hex). May be a 16- or 64-character string; empty if none.

height.description: Height of the block that mined the transaction. `0` for unconfirmed (pending/pool/failed) transfers.

amount.description: Total amount of the transfer, in atomic units.

double_spend_seen.description: `true` if a double spend has been seen for this transaction in the pool.

confirmations.description: Number of confirmations the transaction has accumulated. `0` for unconfirmed transfers.

in.description: Confirmed incoming transfers (present when `in` was requested).

out.description: Confirmed outgoing transfers (present when `out` was requested).

pending.description: Unconfirmed outgoing transfers still awaiting confirmation (present when `pending` was requested).

failed.description: Outgoing transfers that failed to be accepted by the network (present when `failed` was requested).

pool.description: Incoming transfers still in the transaction pool (present when `pool` was requested).

notes.description: Notes for the requested transactions, in the same order as the supplied `txids`. An empty string is returned for any txid with no note.

value.description: The value stored under the requested attribute key.

recipient_name.description: Free-form name of the recipient, for the sender's records. Empty when none was supplied.

unknown_parameters.description: Any URI query parameters that were present but not recognized, returned verbatim (as `key=value` strings).

payment_id.description: The 16-character (8-byte) hex payment id embedded in the integrated address. Reflects the supplied `payment_id`, or the randomly generated one when none was supplied.

is_subaddress.description: `true` if the extracted standard address is a subaddress.

index.description: Zero-based position of the entry in the address book.

description.description: The free-form description stored alongside the address.

entries.description: The requested address book entries (or all entries when no indices were requested).

multisig.description: `true` if the wallet is a multisig wallet.

threshold.description: Number of signatures (M) required to spend, in the M/N multisig scheme. `0` when the wallet is not multisig.

total.description: Total number of participants (N) in the M/N multisig scheme. `0` when the wallet is not multisig.

info.description: Multisig partial key-image info, as a hex-encoded blob, to be shared with the other participants and passed to their `import_multisig_info`.

n_outputs.description: Number of outputs signed by the imported multisig info.

multisig_info.description: The next round's key-exchange message string, to be shared with the other participants and passed to the next `exchange_multisig_keys`. Empty on the final round.

tx_data_hex.description: The updated multisig transaction set, as a hex-encoded blob, carrying this participant's signature. Pass it to the next signer or, once enough signatures are present, to `submit_multisig`.

tx_hash_list.description: Hashes of the transactions, hex-encoded. Populated only once the transaction set has gathered enough signatures to be fully signed.

size.description: Estimated size of the transaction, in bytes.

weight.description: Estimated weight of the transaction, used for fee calculation.

priority.description: The wallet's current default fee priority, adjusted for network conditions (1=unimportant, 2=normal, 3=elevated, 4=priority).

methods.name: get_balance
methods.description:
Alias: `getbalance`

Return the wallet's balance for an account, optionally broken down per subaddress.

params.name: account_index
params.description: Index of the account to query. (Default: `0`, the primary account.)

params.name: address_indices
params.description: Restrict the per-subaddress breakdown to these subaddress indices. (Default: all subaddresses with a balance.)

params.name: all_accounts
params.description: If `true`, return the balance across all accounts instead of a single account. (Default: `false`.)

params.name: strict
params.description: If `true`, only count outputs that have been fully confirmed and processed. (Default: `false`.)

examples.name: Balance of the primary account and first subaddress
examples.description: Fetch the balance for account 0 with a per-subaddress breakdown of subaddress 0.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Send monero to one or more recipients in a single transaction. Fails with a 'transaction would be too large' error if the funds cannot fit in one transaction; use `transfer_split` in that case.

params.name: destinations
params.description: List of {amount, address} destinations to receive the funds. At least one is required.

params.name: account_index
params.description: Index of the account to draw the funds from. (Default: `0`, the primary account.)

params.name: subaddr_indices
params.description: Restrict the spend to outputs of these subaddress indices within the account. (Default: all subaddresses.)

params.name: subtract_fee_from_outputs
params.description: Indices into `destinations` whose amounts should each be reduced to pay a share of the fee, instead of taking the fee from the change. (Default: empty, fee taken from change.)

params.name: priority
params.description: Priority/fee multiplier for the transaction: `0` default, `1` unimportant, `2` normal, `3` elevated, `4` priority. (Default: `0`.)

params.name: ring_size
params.description: Number of outputs in the ring (decoys + real input). (Default: `0`, which lets the wallet pick the network-mandated value, currently 16.)

params.name: unlock_time
params.description: Number of blocks before the funds can be spent. Must be `0`; a non-zero value is rejected. (Default: `0`.)

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Standalone (long) payment id, hex-encoded. Obsolete and rejected if non-empty; use integrated addresses or subaddresses instead. (Default: empty.)

params.name: get_tx_key
params.description: If `true`, return the transaction secret key in the response. (Default: `false`.)

params.name: do_not_relay
params.description: If `true`, build the transaction but do not broadcast it to the network. (Default: `false`.)

params.name: get_tx_hex
params.description: If `true`, return the raw transaction as hex (`tx_blob`). (Default: `false`.)

params.name: get_tx_metadata
params.description: If `true`, return the transaction metadata (`tx_metadata`) for later relaying. (Default: `false`.)

params.description: List of the key-exchange message strings produced by every other participant's `prepare_multisig`.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Number of signatures (M) required to spend, in the M/N multisig scheme. Must be at least 2 and no greater than the number of participants.

params.name: password
params.description: The wallet password, used to re-encrypt the wallet's keys after the multisig conversion. (Default: empty.)

examples.name: Make a 2/2 multisig wallet
examples.description: Combine the other participant's key-exchange message into a 2/2 multisig wallet.

methods.name: export_multisig_info
methods.description: Export this participant's multisig partial key-image info, to be shared with the other participants and imported via their `import_multisig_info`. This is required so each multisig wallet can compute correct balances and key images. The wallet must be multisig and fully formed.

examples.name: Export multisig info
examples.description: Return this participant's multisig key-image info as a hex blob.

methods.name: import_multisig_info
methods.description: Import the multisig partial key-image info exported by the other participants (via their `export_multisig_info`). At least `threshold - 1` participants' info is required. The wallet must be multisig and fully formed.

params.name: info
params.description: List of the hex-encoded multisig info blobs produced by the other participants' `export_multisig_info`. Must contain at least `threshold - 1` entries.

params.name: refresh_after_import
params.description: If `true`, refresh the wallet (and, when the daemon is trusted, rescan spent status) after importing. (Default: `true`.)

examples.name: Import multisig info from a co-signer
examples.description: Import one co-signer's exported multisig key-image info.

methods.name: exchange_multisig_keys
methods.description: Perform the next round of multisig key exchange using the key-exchange messages from `make_multisig` (or a previous `exchange_multisig_keys` round) shared by the other participants. Repeat with each round's output until the returned `multisig_info` is empty and the wallet becomes ready, which is when an `address` is returned. Needed for schemes that require more than one key-exchange round (e.g. N/N where N>2, or M/N).

params.name: password
params.description: The wallet password, used to re-encrypt the wallet's keys after the exchange round. (Default: empty.)

params.name: multisig_info
params.description: List of this round's key-exchange message strings from the other participants. Must contain at least `total - 1` entries.

params.name: force_update_use_with_caution
params.description: Force the key-exchange update on the final round even if fewer messages than expected are supplied. Intended only for one-off key recovery; use with caution. (Default: `false`.)

examples.name: Final key-exchange round for a 2/3 wallet
examples.description: Run the final key-exchange round, finalizing the wallet and returning its address.

methods.name: sign_multisig
methods.description: Add this participant's signature to a partially-signed multisig transaction set (as produced by `transfer` with `do_not_relay`, or by another participant's `sign_multisig`). Returns the updated transaction set; once it has gathered `threshold` signatures, the transaction hashes are also returned and it can be broadcast with `submit_multisig`.

params.name: tx_data_hex
params.description: The multisig transaction set to sign, as a hex-encoded blob.

examples.name: Sign a multisig transaction
examples.description: Add a signature to a multisig transaction set, completing it.

methods.name: submit_multisig
methods.description: Broadcast a fully-signed multisig transaction set (as produced once `sign_multisig` has gathered `threshold` signatures) to the network. Fails if the transaction set has not been signed by enough participants.

params.name: tx_data_hex
params.description: The fully-signed multisig transaction set to submit, as a hex-encoded blob.

examples.name: Submit a signed multisig transaction
examples.description: Broadcast a fully-signed multisig transaction set and return its hash.

methods.name: finalize_multisig
methods.description: Deprecated and non-functional. This was historically the last step of the older multisig key-exchange flow, but in this version the handler is a no-op that always returns an error; use `exchange_multisig_keys` to finalize a multisig wallet instead. Documented here only because it remains registered in the JSON-RPC map.

examples.name: Call the deprecated finalize_multisig
examples.description: The handler always fails; no successful result is produced.

methods.name: create_wallet
methods.description: Create a new wallet. The wallet is generated with a fresh seed in the given language and becomes the open wallet, replacing any currently-open wallet (which is stored first). The `--wallet-dir` option must have been supplied when starting monero-wallet-rpc.

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the wallet file to create, relative to the configured `--wallet-dir`. Must not contain path separators. If empty, an in-memory wallet is created and not written to disk. (Default: empty.)

params.name: password
params.description: Password to encrypt the new wallet with. (Default: empty.)

params.name: language
params.description: Language for the wallet's mnemonic seed, in English (e.g. `English`, `Spanish`). Must be one of the languages returned by `get_languages`; an unknown or empty value is rejected.

examples.name: Create a new English-seed wallet
examples.description: Create a password-protected wallet file with an English mnemonic seed.

params.name: filename

params.name: password
params.description: Password that decrypts the wallet file. (Default: empty.)

params.name: autosave_current
params.description: If `true`, store the currently-open wallet to disk before opening the new one. (Default: `true`.)

params.name: autosave_current

examples.name: Close the open wallet

methods.name: generate_from_keys
methods.description: Create a new wallet from a public address and the corresponding private keys. Supplying a spend key produces a full wallet; omitting it produces a watch-only wallet (view key only). The new wallet becomes the open wallet. The `--wallet-dir` option must have been supplied when starting monero-wallet-rpc.

params.name: restore_height
params.description: Block height from which the wallet should start scanning for transactions. (Default: `0`.)

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the wallet file to create, relative to the configured `--wallet-dir`. Must not contain path separators. If empty, an in-memory wallet is created and not written to disk. (Default: empty.)

params.name: address
params.description: The wallet's primary (base58-encoded) public address.

params.name: spendkey
params.description: Private spend key, as a 64-character hex string. If omitted or empty, a watch-only wallet is generated. (Default: empty.)

params.name: viewkey
params.description: Private view key, as a 64-character hex string.

params.name: password
params.description: Password to encrypt the new wallet with. (Default: empty.)

params.name: autosave_current
params.description: If `true`, store the currently-open wallet to disk before generating the new one. (Default: `true`.)

params.name: language
params.description: Seed language for the new wallet, in English (e.g. `English`). If empty, no seed language is set. (Default: empty.)

examples.name: Restore a wallet from keys
examples.description: Generate a wallet from an address, view key, and spend key.

methods.name: restore_deterministic_wallet
methods.description: Create and restore a wallet from a 25-word (deterministic) mnemonic seed. The restored wallet becomes the open wallet. The `--wallet-dir` option must have been supplied when starting monero-wallet-rpc.

params.name: restore_height
params.description: Block height from which the wallet should start scanning for transactions. (Default: `0`.)

params.name: filename

params.name: seed
params.description: The mnemonic seed (typically 25 words) to restore the wallet from.

params.name: seed_offset
params.description: Optional passphrase used to offset (encrypt) the seed. The same offset must be supplied to recover the wallet. (Default: empty.)

params.name: password
params.description: Password to encrypt the new wallet with. (Default: empty.)

params.name: language
params.description: Seed language for the restored wallet, in English (e.g. `English`). (Default: empty.)

params.name: autosave_current
params.description: If `true`, store the currently-open wallet to disk before restoring the new one. (Default: `true`.)

params.name: enable_multisig_experimental
params.description: If `true`, allow restoring from an experimental multisig seed (skips the standard Electrum word-list verification). Not compatible with `seed_offset`. (Default: `false`.)

examples.name: Restore from a mnemonic seed
